summary: A multi clinic group with a Harley Street site appears to lose treatment bookings to dead menu parents and two booking paths.

findings.problem: Top level menu items such as Treatments, Locations, About and Laser treatments appear to link to #, and the hero button appears to link to an anchor that does not exist.
findings.cost: Patients exploring treatments hit dead ends.
findings.fix: Working pages behind every menu item.

findings.problem: The header Book a Treatment button appears to go to a contact page while Book online goes to a separate booking site.
findings.cost: Two booking paths confuse patients and lose bookings.

findings.problem: Clinic locations appear to differ between the footer, menu and contact form, and no opening hours appear.
findings.cost: Patients cannot tell where you are or when you are open.
findings.fix: One location list and visible hours.

findings.problem: Typos such as chat though your skin concerns appear, along with a Section Break form label and only one testimonial.
findings.cost: Typos and leftover labels weaken a medical brand and proof is thin.
